title: [review] PrefixDelegations has no revocation API; 64-entry exhaustion permanent until process restart
description: P2, wave-5 review. rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:199-248: PrefixDelegations exposes only delegate/authorizes/len/is_empty. On Err(Capacity) the only recovery is a process restart (table volatile by design). A mis-delegation to the wrong key cannot be undone without restarting the border router. Fix: add revoke(public_key, prefix_len, prefix) and optionally clear_origin(public_key); trivial against the HashMap<key, HashSet<(len,prefix)>> layout; add tests (revoke then deny; revoke then re-delegate; revoke unknown is Ok/noop).
